posts.body: I know this reply is late, I haven't been on geobaby for quite some time. Did you find the EZ Twin Nursing Pillow @ Eugene Club? That is where I bought mine. I have 15wk old twins myself. I didn't use mine as long & as many times as I expected too, it's in excellent shape if you want to buy mine. It's light blue. Send me PM. I also have a barely used Ameda BreastPump w/backpack (never used backpack) that I was very happy with. I even liked it better than the hospital grade one. I just haven't had the time to post if for sale.
